_readme: WHO A FIRM MANAGER IS TOLD TO CONTACT when we refuse a prompt they pasted, or when
TO CHANGE IT: edit the one line below, save the file, done. It takes effect on the
very next check — there is no restart, no rebuild and no deploy step. Nothing else
in the app needs changing to match.
If this file is deleted, renamed, or the address is left blank or malformed, the app
falls back to mike@advisor-e.com rather than showing a firm manager a broken link or
a refusal with nowhere to go. The design forbids a refusal with no route back to a
person (design/PROMPT-CONTRIBUTION-SAFETY.md §5), so this cannot be allowed to fail
Set by Mike, 2026-08-25: 'for now, they can send it to mike@advisor-e.com'.
